messages:
customer-support: FYI, ACME (acct acme-42) just reported 400 schema errors on /v1/invoke immediately after the midday deploy. They send: 'toolcall schema validation failed'. Can someone triage?

maya: Noted — which model was promoted?

customer-support: Deploy log shows model redwood-v9.0 (canary 15% us-west-2). They included a minimal failing payload: 
```json
{
  "tool": "extract_entities",
  "args": {
    "text": "Order #1234: 2x Widget A"
  }
}
```

juan: I see repeated rejects in the runtime logs: `ToolSchemaReject: missing required field \"context\" for tool extract_entities_v2` but note the customer called `extract_entities` (legacy). Looks like selector routed to extract_entities_v2 variant with stricter schema.

liz: Also there's a small auth error line preceding some rejects: `403 tool_access_denied svc_token=st-****` — token rotation PR merged yesterday might have introduced a short window where the tool resolver couldn't call certain tool backends.

allen: Log snippet from the canary host: 
```
2026-03-17T18:12:04Z [INFO] deploy-bot: promoted redwood-v9.0 canary=15% region=us-west-2
2026-03-17T18:12:17Z [WARN] router: selected tool extract_entities_v2 for selector="nlp:entity:best" (confidence=0.62)
2026-03-17T18:12:17Z [ERROR] tool-exec: ToolSchemaReject reason="missing field: args.context" request_id=req-0a1b2c
2026-03-17T18:12:18Z [ERROR] auth: tool call denied svc=tool-exec backoff=0.5s svc_token=st-xxxx
```
maya: So two distinct failure modes: (1) model variant is choosing the newer tool variant with different required args, causing schema errors; (2) some calls hit tool backend 403 due to a token edge-case. Both started post-v9.0 canary.

customer-support: ACME also reported an increase in latency and saw client retries, causing a billing spike on their side — they're upset.

juan: Repro steps I used (local): 
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/invoke \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "X-Model: redwood-v9.0-canary" \
  -d '{"tool":"extract_entities","args":{"text":"Ship to 9 Elm St"}}'
```
Expected: tool returns entities array. Observed: 400 / ToolSchemaReject or 403 / tool_access_denied intermittently.

liz: Checking selector behavior — v9.0 changed the tool selection priors for `nlp:entity:best` to prefer v2 when confidence >0.6. That explains the variant choice. We missed a migration shim to accept legacy payloads.

allen: Can we hotfix the selector weighting to favor legacy for canary until tooling accepts legacy args? Or add an adapter in the tool-resolver that coerces missing `context`-> null?

maya: Short-term plan: pause canary traffic and roll back canary model routing to v8.5 for us-west-2. Also open a rollback ticket for global canary hold. Anyone opposed?

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0585 - model v9.0 canary -> toolcall regressions. Assigned: maya, juan, liz, allen.

juan: I can roll back the canary route (15% -> 0) in ~2m. I recommend also revoking the token that caused 403s and re-issuing a non-rotated token for the tool-exec pool (short-lived).

maya: Do it. Also capture a sample of failing requests for postmortem. Customer asked for ETA.

customer-support: Told ACME we paused the canary and are investigating; promised update in 30m. They want a contact point — assigned to Allen.

allen: Rolling back now. 

deploy-bot: Rollback initiated: redwood-v9.0 canary -> decrease to 0% in us-west-2 by juan at 2026-03-17T18:15:02Z.

juan: Rollback confirmed. Traffic back to redwood-v8.5 in us-west-2. No new rejects in the last 2 mins of logs.

liz: Follow-ups: (1) quick shim to tool-resolver to accept legacy extract_entities payload (coerce args.context=null), (2) revert selector change for `nlp:entity:best` in v9.0 until adapters shipped, (3) audit token rotation window and fix rotation job ordering. I'll open PRs for 1 & 2.

maya: Good. Please add repro artifacts to INC-2026-0585 and tag customer-support. We'll schedule a postmortem after stabilization.

sre-oncall: Monitoring — latency and 5xxs trending back to baseline post-rollback. Keeping watch for any residual retries causing billing anomalies.

customer-support: ACME acknowledged rollback and is relieved. They asked for a runbook update so we can avoid this in future.

allen: Noted. I'll follow up with ACME account exec and follow the postmortem action items.

maya: Thanks all — will draft postmortem and mitigation steps. If anyone sees residual 403s, ping here.
